book.name: DJAMIYULWALAŊUWUY DHÄWU
book.title: 1 SAMUEL Ḻakarama yukurra dhäwu Djamiyulwalaŋuwuy ga Djolwalaŋuwuy

content: Ga yuwalknha bitjarranydja maḻŋ'thurruna. Wiripuŋuyunydja waluyu Bilitjiyapuyŋunydja nyäṉ'thurrunana lili yana, bunharaminana yukurrana walala Yitjuralpuyŋuna, ga guḻku'na dhika burakinanydja.
Ga Djolwu ḻurrkun' gäthu'mirriŋu walala burakinayi,
Djonathan ga märrma' biyapul rakunydhinanydja ŋuriŋiyinydja waluyu,
ga Djolnydja ŋayipinydja ga gaṯpurrthina burakina bonarra'yu.

Bala ŋayi waŋana nhanukalaŋuwala djämamirriwala bitjarra, “Buŋana ŋarranha go, rakunyguŋana, märr ŋarranha yurru yakana ŋuruŋu Bilitjiyapuyŋuyunydja märrama.” Yurru ŋunhi ḏarramunydja waŋana yaka'yurruna, yakana ŋayi ŋanya ŋula bumaranydja liŋgu ŋayi ŋunhi barrarinana. Bala Djol bunharaminanydja dharpunhaminanydja ŋanyapinyay ŋayi ŋuriŋi nhanukiyingalana mandjawakthu.

Ga ŋunhi walala Bilitjiyapuyŋuyu ŋäkulanydja ŋunhi Djolnydja liŋguna rakunynha, wirrkina walalanydja dhika galŋa‐ŋamathinana; walala marrtjina lili, ga gulkthurruna ŋanya muḻkurrnha, ga rumbalnydja ŋanya walala dhuḻ'yurrunana ŋunha galki dhälili ḻoḻulili nhäyikayu

Yurru walala ŋunhi Yitjuralpuyŋunydja ḏarramuwurru beyaṉumiriwnha dhika wäŋgaŋala ŋunhimalayi wäŋalili, ga yupmaraŋala ŋanya Djolnha rumbalnydja, bala dhalkaraŋalana. Bala walala nyä'yunminanydja nhanŋu yukurrana Djolwu 7 walunydja ŋupara.
